name: ASN.1 Viewer
description: Expand DER bytes into a structure tree to debug certificates, keys and signatures.

examples.label: View the DER structure tree of a leaf certificate

hints.maxDepth: Leave empty or use 0 for the default of 32 levels; the ceiling is 64.
hints.limit: The input limit is 1 MB: deeply nested DER is rejected on size before it is parsed.
hints.safe: Read-only: only the structure is parsed, the semantics are not validated.

faq.q: What does the #2 in front of a tag mean?
faq.a: It is the tag number; the following universal / context word is the ASN.1 class.

faq.q: Why does some node say truncated?
faq.a: Its children exceed the configured expansion depth and were not expanded further.

faq.q: Can I read the OIDs inside extensions?
faq.a: An OID is the dotted identifier of an extension; the viewer shows it together with the raw bytes.
